# Library test fixtures

- `jbig2_symbol_offset.pdf` and `bug_jpx.pdf`: from the PDF.js test suite
  (https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js, commit ef62f31f2486d7cf2c3854b2db4520b9ca389b2f, `test/pdfs/`), Apache License 2.0.
  A JBIG2 image and a JPEG 2000 image; both decode only with PDF.js's wasm decoders.
- Everything else here is generated by `scripts/make-fixtures.py`.
